selector.why: The evidence of a spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli, along with positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3, and the presence of a wild-type GIST suggested by somatic genetic analysis and germline testing, decided the diagnosis.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli, along with positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3, and the presence of a wild-type GIST suggested by somatic genetic analysis and germline testing, decided the diagnosis.

support_spans: a retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass measuring 1.2 × 8.6 × 10.7 cm
EUS-guided FNA of an oval, hypoechoic posterior mediastinal lesion (68 × 70 mm) obtained a core biopsy that demonstrated a spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Immunohistochemical staining was positive for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
Somatic genetic analysis of cKIT and PDGFRA revealed no mutations, and germline testing was positive for NF1, suggesting wild-type GIST
